page.overview:
Who is Greg's Family?

Greg's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Greg from Fetch, the first story of Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch.

Greg is the protagonist of the second Fazbear Frights book's first story.

Darrin, aka Uncle Dare, is a major character in Fetch.

Later, Hillary takes a part-time job as a front desk clerk at one of the hotels. One day, Hillary and Steven get caught up in an intense discussion and simply say "Okay" when Greg asks if his friends could come over. Later, Dare is attacked and gets his finger bitten off. Hillary comes downstairs and finds Greg at the door, and when he notices she's crying she explains what happened. Greg goes outside and eventually Hillary follows him out to inform him that Dare will be in surgery for a while. When Greg is taken to a police station, Hillary travels all the way from Olympia with tears in her eyes. Once home, Steven berates Greg and Hillary steps in, simply saying Steven's name as Greg runs off to his room.
